messages.text:
I turned on reduced motion on my computer, but the cards and the win banner still animate. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Added reduced motion rules in [card.css](/work/src/game/board/card.css:50) to remove card transitions and [status.css](/work/src/game/status/status.css:39) to show the win banner statically. Default motion remains unchanged.

Type checking passed, as did all 138 unit and static tests. The reduced motion browser check passed. The full browser run had 73 passes and two timeouts; both timed out journeys passed when rerun individually. The changed CSS passes Prettier, though the workspace-wide format check flags 23 other files.
